title: Keith's granite front reads like the 1888 photograph
items: 1808 Prairie's granite is now laid as the 1888 photograph shows: a deep rock-faced course and a thin one in turn up to the third floor, with finer, flatter courses above.
The rough checker band under the parapet is laid in staggered rows of lumps that stand out by different amounts, between stepped mouldings. The upper colonnettes have flared capitals.
